title: Installment Change
description: One installment-level action in a refine_proposals request (media_buy.installment_refinement). It names a product by product_id and an installment by its closed canonical reference. It is a request, not a term: nothing in commercial_terms changes shape.

product_id.description: A product the source proposal purchases, or one that product_changes includes in the same request. The seller checks this membership before it resolves installment_ref, so an unauthorized caller never causes reference resolution.

installment_ref.description: Installment the action applies to. An omit names one in the product's installments. An include names an installment of a collection the product's collections name. A reference the seller cannot resolve fails the request at task level with REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND, not as an unsatisfied change.

action.description: include puts the installment in the selection and omit takes it out. It is required, because a drop that silently defaulted to include is the expensive failure. Swapping a slot is one omit plus one include in the same request.
